visual.general_description: Line chart of proteinuria in g/g creatinine against dates from 2018-11-30 to beyond 2022-11-30, with coloured treatment bars across the top, three boxed markers labelled Admission, NGS and Renal biopsy with arrows to the date axis, and a four-item colour legend.
visual.detailed_description: A single blue line plots proteinuria on a vertical axis labelled Proteinuria (g/g creatinine), ticks 0 to 1.2 in steps of 0.2. The horizontal axis carries 25 rotated date tick labels from 2018-11-30 to 2022-11-30 at roughly two-month spacing. The line starts near 0.1 at the left, rises with a small dip to a printed 0.24 label near the 2019-05-31 tick, dips and rises to a printed 0.46 label near the 2019-11-30 tick, continues upward to a printed 0.83 label near the 2021-05-31 tick, drops almost vertically to a printed 0.49 label, then rises steadily to a printed 1.03 label at the right end of the plot. Above the plot are shaded bars: a short pink bar near the 2019-05-31 to 2019-07-31 ticks; a long pale blue bar starting between the 2019-09-30 and 2019-11-30 ticks and running to the right edge; a pale green bar starting just after the 2020-03-31 tick and ending just before the 2020-11-30 tick; a pale yellow bar starting just after the 2020-05-31 tick and ending between the 2021-11-30 and 2022-01-31 ticks; and two pale green bars at the right, one from just after the 2022-05-31 tick to between the 2022-07-31 and 2022-09-30 ticks and one starting just after the 2022-09-30 tick and running to the right end. The legend below reads Prednisolone (pink), Losartan (blue), Cyclosporine (green) and Mycophenolate mofetil (yellow). Three boxes inside the plot read Admission, NGS and Renal biopsy; their arrows point to the axis at about the 2021-05-31 tick, just after the 2021-07-31 tick, and just after the 2022-05-31 tick respectively. No patient name, identifier or other text is visible.

visual.general_description: Five-panel pathology figure: two stained light-microscopy tissue fields (A, B), one green fluorescence image (C) and two grayscale electron micrographs (D, E).
visual.detailed_description: Panels A and B (top row) are pink, purple and magenta stained tissue fields with round cell-rich tufts and pink tubular profiles; B is at higher magnification. Panel C (bottom left) is bright green irregular fluorescent signal on a dark background. Panels D and E (bottom right) are grayscale electron micrographs with dark speckled nuclei, pale lumens and gray layered material. Each panel carries a black circle with its letter at the lower left. No patient identifiers, scale bars or other text are visible.

panels.general_description: Low-power stained tissue section with several round cell-rich tufts, each inside a clear rim, among pink tubular profiles.
panels.detailed_description: A pink and purple stained tissue field. Three round tufts packed with small dark purple nuclei sit in rounded clear spaces: one at the upper left edge, one at the centre-left and one at the lower right. Pink tubular profiles with scattered nuclei fill the right and lower areas, and a thin tissue band separates the tufts. The letter A appears in a black circle at the lower left. No scale bar, patient identifier, annotation arrow or text other than the panel letter is visible.

imaging_modalities.visual_cue: Stained tissue section with purple nuclei and pink cytoplasm

evidence.quote: (A) Hematoxylin and eosin stain (×200).
biopsy findings of C3GN
Light microscopy, immunofluorescence, and electron microscopy findings.

The glomeruli are of moderately increased size and moderately hypercellular involving endocapillary cells. Mesangial interposition is occasionally seen, forming double contours. One glomerulus (8%) exhibits segmental sclerosis. Tubules reveal focal slight atrophy and loss with interstitial fibrosis.

pixel_observations: Three round cell-rich tufts, each inside a clear rim, among pink tubular profiles.
Dense small dark purple nuclei in the tufts and scattered nuclei in the surrounding pink structures.
The letter A in a black circle at the lower left.

panels.general_description: Higher-power stained tissue section dominated by one large round cell-rich tuft with a clear rim and pink-magenta stained areas, with a second tuft at the lower right.
panels.detailed_description: A pink, magenta and purple stained field at higher magnification. One large round tuft occupies the centre, surrounded by a clear rim and a thin pink line; it contains many dark purple nuclei, pink-magenta stained areas in its lower half and small clear spaces. A second partial tuft with nuclei lies at the lower right. Pink tubular profiles with nuclei lie at the left and right, and one small round tubular profile with a pale lumen is at the lower left of the tuft. The letter B appears in a black circle at the lower left. No scale bar, patient identifier, annotation arrow or text other than the panel letter is visible.

Two more partial dark nuclei are at the lower left and right edge, and pale spaces with thin membrane-like lines are at the top. The letter D appears in a black circle at the lower left.
